verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own Admin API with full programmatic access to flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. It also documents API keys meant for 'other tools and automation', Docker-based deployment, and a one-line claim of CI/CD pipeline integration. Together these support headless, UI-free automation, but the CI-specific workflow is only asserted, not documented. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or CI action/plugin, concrete CI pipeline docs or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.
Integrate with popular tools like GitHub, Slack, CI/CD pipelines.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
